In conclusion, the availability of the essential medicine was poor in Hubei province. The price of the essential medicine in Guangdong province was more affordable. It was also to find that some medicine commonly used in these two provinces had no affordability, which indicated that the level of the supply security of the essential medicine as a whole should be improved further.

articleTitle: Risk identification and assessment of the location in the field of tobacco distribution center in Tangshan based on WBS-RBS
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Recently, with the rapid development of logistics industry, the construction of logistics distribution center has become an essential mainstream in the engineering. There is no doubt that the site selection of distribution center is the basis of enterprise's development. However, many risk factors still remain during site selection process. How to recognize these risk factors comprehensively and accurately is very important. This paper mainly adopts the WBS-RBS method during tobacco distribution center site selection process in Tangshan in risk identification.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the relationship between dual pressure and work performance in telecom operators
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Through interview and questionnaire investigation of employees in three major telecom operators, this paper tested the mediating effects of perceived organizational support between challenge stressor-hindrance stressor and work performance. Results showed that challenge stressor not only had a direct positive effect on work performance, but also took an indirect effect through perceived organizational support, whereas improving perceived organizational support could enhance the positive effect between challenge stressor-hindrance stressor and work performance were implied. Hindrance stressor had a direct negative effect on work performance, while the mediating role of perceived organizational support is not significant, which demonstrated that different types of work stressor had different effects on work performance. Implications for stress management and the development of interventions in telecom operators were discussed.

articleTitle: Study on intelligent transportation system based on value of Time-Spatial
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on value of Time-Spatial, this paper analyzes the Time-Spatial characteristics of the transportation: the non-homogeneous value of time, the non-homogeneous and limitation of spatial, the heterogeneity and self-organization of participant, the incompleteness of information. The objective of this study is to evaluate the effects of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) on the basis of value of Time-Spatial and Time-Spatial Convergence (TSC). Comparing with traditional transportation mode, it is obviously that ITS is more efficient. ITS increases the value of Time-Spatial by improving completeness of information. In addition, ITS enhances the ability of converging the Time-Spatial by shortening time distance. Department of transportation can evaluate the efficiency of ITS by measuring indexes of value of Time-Spatial and Time-Spatial Convergence.

articleTitle: Application of PPP in emission-reduction public projects
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: PPP is a new mode of financing and public service. In recent years PPP has been widely applied in China. Energy saving and emission reduction is the project which Chinese government keeps paying high attention to. The Application of PPP financing model in energy saving and emission reduction projects can introduce private capital. It can not only reduce the government's financial pressure, but also promote the development of environmental protection facilities. This paper compares and generalizes the application of PPP abroad, to explore the construction of PPP financing mode in the field of emission-reduction in China; the paper analyzes the existing problems and shortcomings, and puts forward the framework of the construction of PPP financing mode in emission-reduction, in order to help emission reduction career survive and develop healthily in China.

articleTitle: Transmission analysis of the traditional enterprise with the Internet thinking
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the Internet age, application of the Internet has penetrated into people's daily life. It has a great influence on people's daily life and overturns people's traditional conception of thinking. Depending on the Internet's resources integration ability, Internet companies are rapidly rising and affect the traditional industry's core business. Many traditional enterprises have begun to transform itself through the Internet thinking. This paper embarks from the nature of the Internet and with the seven Internet thinking it derived to analysis the transformation of the enterprise model, the enterprise model and the enterprise value chain.

articleTitle: Auditor switching in an enterprise group and opinion shopping
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Opinion shopping has attracted extensive researches in accounting. There have been the changes of auditors to achieve the improvement of audit opinion or opinion shopping in practice. Regulators are also highly concerned about audit opinion shopping. However, the results of empirical researches have not yielded a consistent conclusion. The conventional wisdom in the literature focused on the single public company to study audit switching and opinion shopping. In emerging markets, the business group is the main form of organizations. This paper regards business group as a whole entity to analyze the impact of audit switching on audit opinion. We find that auditors will lose more than one client within a business group if they issue modified opinion to a listed company in the business group. Accounting firm that takes over group business for the first time is easier to cater to the group firm to achieve opinion shopping. And the audit opinion can be improved if the business group switches the auditor. These findings imply that the business group successfully engages in opinion shopping.

articleTitle: Impact of supply chain long-term orientation on product quality: An empirical examination
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The objective of the study is to explore the impact of supply chain long term orientation on product quality and the mediating roles of goal congruence and communications. Data was collected through a Web survey of U.S. manufacturing firms in various industries. Structural equation modeling (LISREL) was used to analyze the data. The results and implications are discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Optimization analysis on e-commerce system of the SF
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, with the widespread popularity of e-commerce and online shopping platform, the express industry ushered in a period of rapid growth. The courier market, showing a wide range of competitive trends, gradually form a courier and mutual penetration of electricity supplier industry pattern. Since its inception, SF is playing out all the logistics service providers, and with firm size, expanding the geographical scope of the service, logistics service providers brand positioning in the minds of consumers have a preconceived notion temerity to cut electricity service provider in the field, consumers have an awareness and acceptance phase, especially in the case of electricity supplier brand shops, to guide the consumer brand awareness even more difficult.

articleTitle: The service efficiency improvement research of freight yard based on the queuing theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In real life, the phenomenon of vehicle queue always happens in loading and unloading freight yard, loading and unloading equipment idle always happens too, the equipment can't be used sufficiently, this is a waste of resources and will cost more. This kind of circumstance appears not only relates to the number of loading and unloading equipment, but also relates to the way of vehicle queue. This paper will apply the queue model, with the help of Matlab to determine the way of vehicle queue and the number of loading and unloading equipment, in order to improve the service efficiency, reduce the operational costs

articleTitle: Consider a buyback contract model with marketing strategy types of game leader
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The enterprises no fear sacrificing profits to keep or enhance the market shares, such as www.JD.com. It means the downstream need order more and sell more. The previous buyback contract literature research is the problem solving solution, all assume the supplier and retailer both are profit oriented and achieve supply chain coordination and Pareto optimality. In this article, we research the supplier is a leader and sales oriented, the retailer is the follower and the profit oriented. And the retailer is required order more than his optimal quantity Analyze the two ways, the enhancing the buyback price or reducing the wholesale price. In the analysis results, the buyback contract parameters are limited by the retained earnings of the sales oriented supplier and the market demand distribution. Numerical examples are given to illustrate contract parameters how to affect the supply chain coordination, the order quantity of the retailer and the profit of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Integrated security system management and incident management from the perspective of organizational structure
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This contribution presents different approach to security management in companies. Current approach focuses on separately managed individual security fields compared to the proposed new approach. This approach is based on integrated security system management. The main objective of this paper, which is based on project “Possibilities of ITIL1 implementation in Commercial Security Industry”, is to propose the model of integrated security system management and incident management from the perspective of organizational structure.

articleTitle: Economic analysis for container shipping route
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Asian container routes are the area where world 10 big ports are concentrated including Busan Port based on container cargo handling records in 2013 and the competition to attract container cargos between such ports is very tough. This paper has developed an economy evaluation model corresponding to change in transshipment cargo volume of neighbor ports in North East Asia classifying to Route 1 and Route 2 with Busan Port as a starting point and carried out an economy evaluation of the sea route, an important data for deciding sea routes and calling ports of the shipping companies by applying this model. As a result of analyzing such 2 routes, the shipping company can develop a more profitable route and the port related government authority or operational institution of each country can figure out the threshold of feeder cargo volume in economic viewpoint.

articleTitle: Research on city logistics optimization—Based on cloud philosophy
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the life style changing, the distribution has become an indispensable part of people. However, the contradiction between the city-distribution's timeliness and the city traffic's capacity as well as the environment stress makes the last one kilometer distribution become a hot topic. On this issue, Based on the mechanism of the resource store, management and feedback, the authors find the city logistics cloud, and by means of strategy of “cluster first, distribution secondly”, the authors close the city logistics system in a fixed period of time. The authors cluster the distribution area and customers for the available carriers and make them distribute after the partition.

articleTitle: Rubric use in financial courses' bilingual teaching
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This report proposes the rubric use in financial courses' bilingual teaching, more specifically, the method lecturers apply to better understand teaching result. It describes the rubric design, explains mechanism of employing SME to analyze rubric results, reports the application on students of CTBU in year 2014 and identifies gaps for further improvement.

articleTitle: The impact path research of negative IWOM on brand equity based on cognitive trust
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper, utilizing correlation analysis and path analysis methods, researches the impact path of negative Internet word related to the mouth on brand equity and quality through cognitive trust concept by regarding universal consumers as study principal body. This research aims to further promote the IWOM research system in China. The empirical conclusions unveil some relationship: (1) the cognitive trust of negative IWOM has negative correlation with cognitive qualified and positively correlated with the brand association at the 0.05 level of significance, however, no prominent correlation was figured out between cognitive trust and brand loyalty; (2) the cognitive trust of negative IWOM influences the brand association directly, meanwhile indirectly, the risk perception influences brand association indirectly, which can conclude and abstract the effect mechanism of the cognitive trust of negative IWOM on brand equity and quality.

articleTitle: Special spare parts management in 4s enterprise
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Spare parts management always plays an important role in 4S enterprise. How to predict the demand is essential to reduce the cost of inventory and improve efficiency. Some special parts which customer urgently need are high value and easy to devalue. The prediction of these parts is especially important. This paper blends the bathtub curve with the Regression analysis and Weibull distribution to predict the demand of spare parts, solving the problem and having a reality significance.

articleTitle: Analysis of characteristics of humanitarian supplies demand
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By analyzing the characteristic of humanitarian goods, focus on analysis of the uncertain of humanitarian supplies demand, look for factors of humanitarian supplies demand associated with gray relational analysis, and get the main factors affecting the demand uncertainty of humanitarian supplies. And establish a gray forecasting model and make an empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Large scale trajectory data management
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, the wide usage of GPS-enabled devices has generated vast volumes of spatio temporal streams of location data, which raising management challenges, such as efficient storage and querying. Therefore, compression techniques are inevitable also in the field of moving object databases. In this paper, we propose a line simplification technique to compress moving object trajectories, which take the change of moving direction as the judgmental threshold to collect GPS points. The efficiency of our technique is demonstrated through an extensive experimental evaluation on trajectory data using real trajectory datasets collected by Geolife project.

articleTitle: Classified information system security risk assessment model of the research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The development of information technology makes the government and military departments put forward higher request to the information system security problem. Its uniqueness, classified information system security risk assessment differs from the common information security system. Based on classified information system as the research object, firstly, the characteristics of the classified information system, for its uniqueness to the existing information security risk assessment method for analysis and evaluation. Then evaluation model based on the AHP (analytic hierarchy process) and grey theory is introduced into the classified information system security risk assessment. For classified information system safety risk assessment provides a new thought of technology. Finally through the model validation, confirmed this model suitable for practically classified information system security risk assessment.

articleTitle: Analysis of the electric vehicle charging station's layout in Beijing based on improved traveling simulation model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the popularity of electric vehicles, some enterprises have manufactured many electric and hybrid electric vehicles. The construction of charging stations becomes more urgent. More and more papers studied the rationality of charging station's layout by simulation models. This paper improved the travelling simulation model of electric vehicles based on the following points: road network and population density, which make the traveling simulation model closer to reality. We researched the situation of charging stations in Beijing and used a heuristic method to simulate visiting frequency of charging stations and roads. Finally, we put forward reasonable proposals for the construction of charging stations in Beijing.

articleTitle: The impetus mechanism of sustainable innovation in manufacturing enterprises under globalization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The impetus mechanism of sustainable innovation in manufacturing enterprises under globalization is studied in the paper. On the basis of analyzing the existing studies on innovation in impetus mechanism, new factors influencing sustainable innovation in manufacturing enterprises under globalization are concluded as internal and external ones. The internal motivating factors include the entrepreneur's sustainable innovation spirit, sustainable development goals of the enterprise, the entrepreneur and staff's sustainable innovation driven by interests, the sustainable innovation ability of the enterprises, the sustainable innovation culture of the enterprises, and the institutional structure of the enterprises; while the external ones include the development of science and technology, the market requirements and competition, the government policy, and the social, economic, cultural and ecological environment. Based on the abovementioned work, an impetus mechanism model of sustainable innovation in manufacturing enterprises under globalization is constructed through analysis and explained at the same time.

articleTitle: A chance-constrained programming model for medical resources order and distribution scheduling based on time-space network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies the medical resources order and distribution scheduling problem with stochastic demand. A chance-constrained programming model is proposed based on time-space network with the objective of minimizing the hospital's total operating costs. Generic algorithm is employed to solve the optimization model. The numerical test results show the good performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on the balance of Shanghai FTZ's logistics supply and different countries' logistics demand
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper constructs the evaluation index system of the balance of logistics supply and demand between Shanghai FTZ and different countries, and reasonably divides logistics supply of Shanghai FTZ and logistics demand of different countries to make Shanghai FTZ logistics supply capacity that assigns to different countries corresponding to the different countries' logistics demand to Shanghai FTZ. This paper establishes the balance evaluation model of logistics supply and demand by applying the DEA and put forward the coordination mode between Shanghai FTZ logistics supply and different countries' logistics demand.

articleTitle: Patent-based association analysis for technological convergence of IT and BT
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent innovative trends, one of the most notable features is technological convergence. The technological convergence of information technology (IT) and biotechnology (BT) is important for our social, science, and lives. However, many studies focused on the convergence of IT and BT only from the standpoint of two technologies, such studies may miss some interesting information. To address this limitation, we use patent-based association analysis to explore technological convergence of IT and BT. The contribution of this paper is that it provides evidences for the convergence of IT and BT from two or more technologies, not just two technologies. This gives managerial implications for each sector of IT and BT.

articleTitle: Total Landed Cost for international sourcing decisions
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Total Landed Cost (TLC) often comprise a large share of the total international sourcing cost and thereby determine the cost-saving potential. Therefore, the literature proposes a number of methods to evaluate the TLC. Nevertheless, the ordinary way and especially the usage of information systems (IS) have not been examined satisfactory. This study focusses which kind of IS are used in this domain and how they perform. As a result, more than one-half of survey respondents are not using IS, although IS lead to a significantly higher perceived performance. An Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA) indicates that non-enterprise resource planning systems (non-ERP) reached a higher performance in comparison to ERP, especially because of the flexibility of the cost calculation. Based on the research results, the authors discuss some useful implications.

articleTitle: Architecture design and implementation of Beijing digital school system based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper introduces the architecture design of Beijing digital school system which describes specific functions and modules of five layers, i.e. the interface layer, the application layer, the support layer, the data layer and the base layer. Beijing digital school system contains mobile digital school and web digital school. The article presents the architecture design of the mobile platform and the web platform. Improve resource utilization through dynamic migration mechanisms, and use Honey bee forager algorithm to optimize resource allocation. Cloud computing is a business computing model. The low cost, efficient, virtualized, highly scalable and versatile features meet the needs of this system. Through the architecture design of the mobile platform and web platform,combined with the cloud service model, cloud computing infrastructure and technologies ,implement the cloud-based Beijing digital school system.

articleTitle: Relational embeddedness impacts on service innovation performance: The mediating role of network competence
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on a survey of 243 service providing enterprises in South China, this study investigates the effects of relational embeddedness and network competence on service innovation performance respectively, the mechanisms by which network competence mediates the relationship between relational embeddedness and service innovation were also discussed. Results show that both relational embeddedness and network competence are positively related to service innovation performance; network competence has a fully mediating effect on the relationship of relational embeddedness and service innovation performance.

articleTitle: 3PL selection criteria and their correlations of external environmental factors-an empirical study of Taiwan IC industry
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: External environment strongly influences the strategy choice of an enterprise. Due to the fierce global competition, an enterprise determines to focus its main resource on core competence and outsources its logistic operation to a dedicated third-party logistics (3PL) supplier is a strategic decision to reduce the operation cost and in the meantime to improve the logistic service quality. The prior research showed that the decision of logistics outsourcing had been affected by external environmental factors, i.e., dynamism, hostility and heterogeneity. The IC industry in Taiwan has a unique vertically disintegrated structure that consists of various firms specializing in three segmentations of the value chain, i.e., upstream IC design, midstream IC manufacturing and downstream IC assembly and final testing. To achieve the logistics efficiency along the IC supply chain, the three segmentations have collaborated with 3PLs closely to meet the relentless market demand. This research aims to identify the different 3PL selection criteria of the three major segmentations of IC industry and further explore to what extent external environment affects the three segmentations when considering 3PL selection criteria.

articleTitle: The impacts of internal innovation orientation and external co-production on service innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the relations among internal innovation orientation, external co-production, business relation and service innovation performance. Using Structure Equation Model and Amos 20.0 to test the direct effect of constructs and using SPSS liner regression to test the moderating effect of business relations. Through an empirical survey of 161 samples in South China, the research findings show that: (1) Internal innovation orientation has a positive impact on external co-production. (2) External co-production has a positive impact on service innovation performance. (3) Business relations with partners can moderate the relations between the innovation orientation and co-production. The study suggests that managers should focus on the combination of internal innovation orientation and some specific innovation behaviors. And companies in network should strengthen the co-production with external partners to promote innovation.

articleTitle: A critical review of manufacturing and supply chain research through co-words analysis: 2004–2014
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The present work carries out a comprehensive and systematic review of academic research on supply chain and manufacturing flexibility, using -a specific type of bibliometric indicator-co-words analysis. This approach provides a more methodical view of the development and size of this research line, synthesise and organise existing knowledge through the identification of research clusters, and identify potential avenues for future research. The results reveal that this field has a rich, complex structure and various branches of topics with different levels of development. We found well developed themes, such as Performance; emerging themes, such as Perspective and Product Development; peripheral themes, such as Model; and specialized themes, such as Marketing Channel.

articleTitle: Analysis on information value of big data in Internet finance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Internet finance is an emerging area which combines traditional finance industry and Internet spirit. In this paper we have analyzed the positive information value of big data in Internet finance business activities, such as the long tail user management, risk supervision, the third party payment, micro credit, crowd funding, online manage money matters, business recommendation, the transaction subject authentication etc, and the negative information value that big data can bring to Internet finance. In the part of empirical analysis, we make the lenders and the borrowers of micro credit business as an example, to construct the incomplete information static game model, for proving big data have the information value in Internet finance business activities, and illustrate the information value of big data by instance data.

articleTitle: Analysis of low-carbon transport in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper first analyses the status quo of transportation development in Beijing. Then, we use experiment approach to calculate carbon emissions. After fitting transportation carbon emissions by utilizing EKC curve, we forecast the peak of carbon emissions up to 2188.8315 ten thousand tons. And when it is around 2020, it will peak. Last, we provide some strategies on the development of low-carbon transportation in terms of transportation policy supply, demand and urban spatial policy.

articleTitle: Strategic considerations for the formation of internet platform products
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Platforms as one of the key concepts behind many of the most successful online services play a vital role in today's internet landscape. In China a number of highly competitive products has evolved in the shadow of the BAT giants Baidu, Alibaba and Tencent. In this highly dynamic market, valuable findings regarding the formulation and evaluation of platform strategies can be established. This paper is the result of the study of significant processes and events in the Chinese internet platform market. The high growth rate of the market creates a dynamic setting that provides a unique research opportunity which is used in this study to draw practically relevant conclusions from a number of observations in the Chinese market, while verifying those conclusions with the theoretical basis that has been established in relevant literature. The main contribution of this study is thus to distill main practical relevant findings from a fast growing, dynamic market backed by an academic theoretical basis to establish a number of conclusions that serve as guidelines for practitioners in the online platform business. The study reveals two major creation scenarios for platform products in praxis: The transformation of existing products and new designs from scratch. It is of practical relevance to know the major pitfalls for either creation scenario, which is the generation of a high user number, often characterized by significant price-cutting or direct bonus payments by the competing platform operators, and the generation of a symmetry between service or product vendors and consumers using a platform. Important factors for either strategy include adequate focus on user demand, a critical mass of diverse users and suppliers and the ability of a platform to convince providers of and contribute to their long-term profitability. Successful strategies in China have been found to center on three cornerstones, namely user satisfaction, provider motivation and the ability to enable and facilitate interaction.

articleTitle: Impacts of power structure on price strategy for CRH express and traditional express under uncertain demand
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to obtain optimal pricing strategy for traditional express that cooperates with CRH express, and further analyze impacts of power structure on their cooperation pricing strategy, in this paper, on the basis of three-stage supply chain, considering the uncertain demands of market, it established pricing game model under centralized control, Nash model when both parties equivalently dominated and Stackelberg game model when both parties respectively dominated, and obtained the optimal agreement freight rate strategy for CRH express and optimal agreement freight volume and market pricing strategy for traditional express in four cases. Conclusions: Agreement freight rate when both parties equivalently dominated was higher than that when both parties respectively dominated. When the dominant transferred from CRH express to traditional express, the market freight rate increased. The supply chain efficiency reached maximum under centralized control mode but reached minimum when traditional express dominated.

articleTitle: Empirical research on evaluation of developmental levels for Chinese rural services industry
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The evaluation index system of rural services is structured as four dimensions: the scale of development, the speed of development, the structure of development and the environment of development. The developmental level of Chinese rural services relating 30 provinces has been evaluated based on principal component analysis method (PCA). The results of evaluation research indicated that the developmental level of rural services among these 30 provinces exhibited obvious and tremendous differences, especially regional differences. The eastern region ranked foremost, followed the middle region, the northeast region and the western region respectively, which is generally correspond to the horizontal gradient pattern of these four economical regions. The average developmental levels of the middle, the northeast and the western regions showed below that of the national level, and the northeast region exhibited unique pattern.

articleTitle: The multidimensional game towards online sellers
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, our e-commerce industry has gained great support from national and local government. So our e-commerce industry's development prospects will be broader. Under the e-commerce environment, the competition towards online sellers has become more and more diverse and dynamic than the traditional competition game model. The rapid development of e-commerce makes more and more companies begin to get involved in this area, the market competition has become much fiercer. The vast majority of sellers on e-commerce platform can be viewed as a small business organization, and those businesses who sell similar products is single point of competition and multi-point competition. The sales strategies and mutual games towards the sellers also become increasingly fierce. At present, the game theory are basically involved in the one-dimensional game, few scholars have presented and applied multidimensional game in products pricing strategy; and few scholars have studied a little about one-dimensional game under the e-commerce environment, which mainly focused on the supply and demand sides 'complete information game. The main contribution of this paper is to introduce multidimensional game to study the game towards multi-sellers under the e-commerce environment, and find the game mechanism towards online sellers, so as to provide references for the optimization of e-commerce environment. On the basis of the analysis of the e-commerce industry's development environment, we make a summary analysis of the competition and game studies which related to the online sellers. At the same time, we analyze the online sellers' strategy studies of opening online shops and marketing from home and abroad. Faced with the complex and variable market's demands, the games towards online sellers have become more flexible. From the multidimensional game theory, we set the game strategic conditions of online sellers who sell homogeneous products. In view of the e-commerce environment, how do those online sellers choose the advertising inputs, related transaction service inputs and commodities pricing strategies in order to maximize their profits, we establish a multi-seller's multidimensional game model under the e-commerce environment and solve the equilibrium condition. Then we make a primary analysis of the equilibrium results and find the existence of online sellers' optimal game strategy equilibrium under the e-commerce environment. This research has certain guidance significance for the optimization of the sellers' game and their competition behaviors under the e-commerce environment.

articleTitle: The mediating role of customers' electronic word-of-mouth between firms' following-up actions and their stock performance in crisis events
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This research focuses on a typical social media platform, i.e. micro-blogging websites, and explores the mediating role of customers' electronic word-of-mouth between firms' crisis management actions and their market value. In doing so, we seek to answer the question of what actions firms should resort to and how should they take those following-up actions after crisis events occurring in current information age. Our analysis is based on a dataset of customers' word-of-mouth behaviors collected from the largest Chinese micro-blogging website, as well as firm's action information collected from public new media sources and firm's performance information in stock market. Upon customers' information processing theory, we hypothesize that firm's action volume, complexity and covering-up character influence customers' word-of-mouth behaviors which further affect firms' market value recovery in crisis events. We expect that while the direct impact of firm's following-up actions on firm's market value during crisis events remains, customers' electronic word-of-mouth behaviors play an important chain effect in between. We also expect that this study will contribute to the business value of social media literature by revealing the instrumental role of customer that helps the finance market understand whether or how firm's wrongdoing leads to a faster/slower performance recovering. In addition, this study conveys important implications to firms' crisis management.

articleTitle: Pricing crowdsourcing services
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies optimal fee schedules of crowdsourcing services. The paper finds that service fees should be an increasing concave function of task prizes. This result implies that optimal service fee rates, measured as the ratios of fees to prizes, decrease with task prizes. The paper shows that low-type crowdsourcing contest sponsors might be priced out of the market under the optimal fee schedule. The paper also finds that crowdsourcing websites should charge higher service fees for hosting consumer-contest type crowdsourcing contests than for research-tournament type crowdsourcing contests.

articleTitle: Promoting efficiency and expediency of approval process for major infrastructure projects
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: There is continuing demand for more and better major infrastructure to achieve sustainable high quality growth in China. Approval process of major infrastructure projects is vital to the successful construction. Ineffective and inefficient decisions lead to irretrievable results, long duration, great financial loss and waste. Therefore, conducting a research in the approval process of the major infrastructure is quite necessary. This paper is aimed at finding the shortages in the approval process of the major infrastructure in China. Comparative case studies of Australia and China were adopted in this research and documentary analysis was employed as the supplementary to facilitate the analysis. Recommendations are provided for achieving greater uniformity and efficiency in approval process for major infrastructure. The solutions have practical implications for approval process of general major infrastructure projects in China.

articleTitle: Analysis on the tactics and benefit of vertical cooperative R&D innovation in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Vertical cooperative innovation during supply chain may overcome the high investment in R&D and uncertainty, and it also can avoid risks, shorten product development cycles. In this paper, a vertical cooperative R&D model is built in the upstream monopoly supply chain based on game theory. The following conclusions is drawn: Monopoly in the upstream vertical cooperative R&D model, with the absorptive capacity of enterprises and the overflow level of the increase in corporate R&D results, the upstream and downstream businesses will increase profits. The upstream monopoly enterprise cannot force the downstream companies to join the cooperative R&D alliance, and undertake research and development costs too much. To maximize profits, the upstream companies can only travel companies in the following bound for the standard to determine the number of member companies and the downstream cost-sharing ratio.

articleTitle: Analysis of the operational risk sources in electric utilities
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The aim of this study is to review the state of the art and the opinion of experts of organizations to define if it is possible to adapt the guidelines issued for the banking sector by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision of the Bank for International Settlements (BCBS-BIS) concerning the administration of the Operational Risks (OpR). After defining the adaptation of BCBS-BIS guidelines to companies different from those of the banking sector, a case study that empirically underpins the feasibility of implementing the BCBS-BIS guidelines is presented. For the selection of the case study a country is defined based on the opinion of the major risk rating agencies and for the selection of the company the criteria is based on the economic and social impact within the selected country. Finally, several OpR in the research unit have been obtained from secondary data sources in the industry, so the foundations have been established for the realization of future ad-hoc research within that organization. Likewise the feasibility of implementing and adapting the BCBS-BIS guidelines in any non-financial sector is also confirmed.

articleTitle: Study on ecological environment impact of urban agricultural products wholesale market distribution system
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The environment problem has aroused people's concern in recent years since the heavy haze weather. Agricultural products logistics, acting as one of the necessary activities to keep people's daily life and the main source of environmental pollution, receives widespread attention in the whole society. Basing on the field survey of agricultural products distribution system in Beijing, we clarify the distribution scheme to be three categories: direct distribution, transfer once distribution and transfer twice distribution in this study. This paper established the evaluation index system to examine the effect of agricultural products distribution system on the environment in Beijing according to the facts and related literature. Further, we use fuzzy integrated evaluation method to compare the actual situation of Xinfadi vegetable distribution in Beijing and the three scenario we simulated base on the key factors. We find that the effect of agricultural products distribution system on the environment can be reduced by increasing the proportion of direct distribution according to actual situation, developing common delivery and selecting reasonable distribution vehicle, promoting the use of professional delivery vehicles, setting up reasonable transit link to optimize the system, and clamping down on excess wholesale market.

articleTitle: Research on income distribution model of supply chain financing based on third-party trading platform
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The stability and effectiveness of supply chain financing union are directly affected by income fluctuation and unequal distribution problems, subsequently making the economic interests of the involved parties impacted. In this paper, the incomes of the parties in the union were distributed using Shapley value from the perspective of cooperative game under the background of the supply chain financing based on third-party trading platform, and then correction factors were weighted by introducing risk correction factors and combining with analytic hierarchy process (AHP), in order to improve the original model. Finally, the feasibility of the scheme was proved using example.

articleTitle: Emotional intelligence and leadership effectiveness in organizations of PR China: A cultural explanation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper tries to shed light on whether emotional intelligence (EI) predicts leadership effectiveness (LE) in the Chinese context. To do this, we apply Bar-On's EI dimensions and LE dimensions in Leadership Effectiveness Analysis as the instrument in this study. The finding, contrast to the hypothesis, is that EI can not predict LE in the Chinese context. As one of the pioneer research in such domain, this study has important literature contribution in cross-cultural leadership effectiveness, and helps companies in talent assessment.

articleTitle: Managing value creation in Knowledge Intensive Business Services organisations
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Value creation is essential in the Knowledge Intensive Business Service (KIBS) industry, due to its problem-solving nature. KIBS organisations need to understand their internal value creation processes as well as the complexity in the environment in order to survive and thrive. This paper investigates how value creation is managed in KIBS organisation through a case study. It then goes on to adopt Beer's Viable System Model (VSM) to propose an organisational design, namely the Value Integration Office (VIO). The VIO focuses on the 5 functions/systems defined by VSM in the meta-system and operation of an organisation in order to manage value creation. This design is implemented in a case study organisation with the aim to adopt a holistic view on value creation within the organisation as well as facilitate future planning function. The implementation and impact of the proposed organisational design are reported in this paper.

articleTitle: Stock price fluctuation under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Basing on EKOP information trading model analysis framework, we selected 50 stocks each as sample from the mainboard, small and medium-sized board and GEM (Growth Enterprises Market) in Chinese stock market for empirical analysis. This paper discusses the fluctuation of stock price under the information asymmetry. Preliminary empirical results show that the average daily turnover rate and probability of informed trading has positive correlation, and it does not conform to the theoretical derivation. As for the empirical improvement, the liquidity risk, average stock price and probability of informed trading as supplementary explanation variables are introduced to do regression analysis. The results show that under the condition of asymmetric information, the higher the stock prices is, the greater the information transaction risk raises; the larger the value of the probability of informed trading becomes, the greater the impact on stock price fluctuation brings; meanwhile, the liquidity risk has no directly influence on the information transaction risk and stock price fluctuation.

articleTitle: Three or four-tier cities FMCG wholesale model changes in internet era
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Three or four-tier cities are the main sales market of FMCG. Currently, grocery stores, mom and pop shops are the main mode of the terminal retailers of FMCG in three or four-tier cities. Their poor management and supplies are mainly from two or three wholesale market. This traditional FMCG sectors circulation patterns have many problems like long links, high transaction costs, low transaction efficiency and etc. As mobile internet technology developed, bingo has integrated the supply chain upstream and downstream resources, and optimized internal management. And it provides service for terminal local retailers in Xuchang. At the end, it has optimized and integrated wholesale FMCG channel. This case uses the method of field research on the analysis of bingo business model, researches into the Bingo Pattern. Ultimately, it provides a reference for the FMCG supply chain integration of other three or four-tier Cities.

articleTitle: A mathematical model for container port integrated scheduling and optimization problem
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Traditionally, container terminal optimizations are excused separately and sequentially. As the seaside and landside operations interact intensively, the sequential planning approaches often hinder obtaining sufficient resource utilization, especially for transshipment hubs. Facing the challenge of simultaneous optimization of berth allocation, quay crane assignment and yard allocation, this paper makes an attempt to remedy the situation of sub-optimizations made by different agents, by devising a comprehensive mathematical model, with the aim of benefiting port operators. Regarding that some transit containers typically require temporary yard stowage, the effect of yard stowage allocation, a major factor to the port operational cost, is elaborated in the paper. The main contribution of this work is the presentation of a compact mixed integer linear programming model.

articleTitle: Research on data fusion of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Data fusion is an important to data mining in the Internet of Things. To deal with the above problems, services in the Internet of Things are to be introduced into the project. Firstly, services in the Internet of Things are researched on a macro-scale to plan out the good definition interfaces and standardized services in order to turn the devices to the service functions and communicate with the heterogeneous devices, and with the equipments and Web services which can be founded and combined freely. Next, by using EJB(enterprise Java beans) as a basic tool and adopting XML(extensible markup language) to collect the multiple and complicated information sources, a food safety data platform based on J2EE(Java to enterprise edition) technology is put forward to ensure the data accuracy and stability. Experiments shows it is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Dynamic incentive mechanism of SSC with win-win consideration
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: For the phenomena that classic principal-agent model can not reflect win-win cooperation and is less concerned about agent's opportunistic decision behavior, this paper introduces principal's value preference parameter reflecting win-win cooperation to incentive model and considers agent's opportunism, establishes Service Supply Chain (SSC) dynamic incentive model, and analyzes model equilibriums. Research showed value preference parameter can effectively coordinate the value relation between service integrator and service provider, impel service provider to improve productive input and decrease opportunistic behavior; implicit incentive has definite substituting function on explicit incentive, under the function of the two incentives, service provider will keep higher productive input level, and its opportunistic input would be controlled effectively at the same time.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation of value assessment in IPR pledge financing based on interval value TOPSIS method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Development of SME is limited by financing difficulties. Intellectual property Right (IPR) pledge financing, the novel financing mode, can ease financing difficulty of SME to some extent, therefore development of SMEs can be effectively supported. However, since there are difficulties in intellectual property right value assessment, risk control and other aspects. Evaluation of IPR pledge financing risk has great significance in the context. In the paper, risk indicators of IPR pledge financing in the aspect of value assessment are established. TOPSIS multi-attribute decision making method based on interval number is selected for evaluating risks for candidate IPR pledge financing project. The method can be applied for improving subjective problem of qualitative indicators assignment in multi-criteria decision-making. Feasibility and effectiveness of the method are proved by the example.

Author Keywords: multi-attributes decision Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Cultural tourism O2O business model innovation-case analysis based on CTRIP
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: It is absolutely not an accidental phenomenon that the development of Internet overlaps with boom of business model research. The emergence of the Internet has greatly promoted the development and study of business models. This article focuses on exploration of O2O business model innovation by analyzing the main type, evolution and driving factor of Chinese Internet business model, taking Ctrip as example. From social prospective, O2O business model improves value and feeling of customer experience as well as the operational efficiency of enterprise value chain and utilization efficiency of social resource. This article has also put forward what Ctrip can enlighten the development of tourism enterprise.

articleTitle: Analysis of China railway passenger volume's influence factors based on principal component regression
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Now the speed of the development of railway passenger transport market has exceeded the freight's, the proportion of passenger transport's income is constantly increasing in the total income, which makes it significant to find a simple and reliable method to analyze the factors that affect China railway passenger transport market. On the basis of relevant study, using the principal component regression theory, which can solve collinearity problems, this paper establish a multiple linear regression model, which has strong practical significance. Moreover, this paper studies how do related variables influence the change of railway passenger volume and the degrees of these influences quantificational.

articleTitle: The study of logistics Industry Competitiveness in Southwestern China and Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: On the basis of modern logistics theory and researches in logistics industry of competitiveness connotation and characteristic by other scholars, this paper lists six indexes of modern evaluation system of logistical Industry Competitiveness: logistics requirement, supply capacity of logistic, logistic infrastructure and talents of logistic. Also, this paper draws a practical study of comparison of logistics competitiveness between southwest China and Guangdong Province by the mean of factors analysis and the conclusion gives the condition of some typical provinces on demand and supply relationships in logistics industry. This paper proposes some development strategies logistics industry for Southwest China.

articleTitle: A research on the comprehensive measure of international competitiveness of Chinese ICT industry
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: ICT industry is already the key of current and future world economic development, becomes the focus of world economic competitions, given the current empirical research on the international competitiveness of the ICT industry is extremely scarce, the research on the comprehensive measure of international competitiveness of Chinese ICT industry can make up the shortfall of the theoretical research and is useful for knowing our ICT status in the world form which we can get the way to improve our international competitiveness of ICT industry . To accurately grasp and scientifically evaluate the level of international competitiveness of the ICT, on the basis of well-known scholars choosing the evaluation index on the combination of the ICT industry's own characteristics, this paper has selected RCA index, MS index, TC index and CA index as measure indexes and weight each index and time sequence through entropy method to comprehensively measure international competitiveness of Chinese ICT industry. The results show the international competitiveness of Chinese ICT industry ranks the second place among 15 countries, with a higher level of international competitiveness.

articleTitle: Inventory optimization research on shampoo products of B2C e-commerce with temporary price discount
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, the demand characteristics of shampoo products with B2C e-commerce environment are firstly analyzed. The issue that retailers provide customers with temporary price discount, and suppliers also offer temporary price discount for retailers is researched. Considering the influence of customers order lead time and payment terms on inventory costs, and then inventory control model is set up.

articleTitle: Budget management of university research funds
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on Complete and Incomplete Contract Theory, the paper analyzes the root causes of different kinds of problems during the process of budget compilation and implementation of university research funds. These problems include false budget, fiddling on expenditure, and hard to monitor and control. Based on these analyses, the paper also provides corresponding strategy. The analysis in the paper shows that the problems in the budget management of university research funds are from asymmetric information and inconsistent interests between the principals and agents under the principal-agent relationships; and also from the opportunism of project manager in the conditions of limited rationality in the competent authorities and management department. Therefore, aiming at the above three causes, the paper provides the methods to control the opportunism during the management on the budget of research funds in universities. The methods include designing effective information management system, establishing effective performance evaluation system and perfect rewards and punishments mechanism, and improving corresponding governance mechanism.

articleTitle: Game analysis and development strategies for supply chain environmental costs internalization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the increasingly distinct environmental problems in our country, internalization of environmental costs becomes an important approach to solve these problems. Internalization of environmental costs in a single enterprise is not strong enough in the process. To accomplish the internalization of the whole supply chain can not only alleviate the contradiction between environment and development, but also enhance the core competitiveness of supply chains and increase operating earnings of enterprises. This paper studies internalization of environmental costs, and conducts game analysis on interest-related parties during the environmental costs internalization of secondary supply chain to find the critical factors that influence the internalization so as to propose corresponding strategies and suggestions.

articleTitle: Analysis on the CDP modes of B2C e-commerce and the design of evaluation index system
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on previous studies, the different forms of Collection and Delivery Point (CDP)currently used by B2C e-commerce business are divided into five types in this paper, i.e., the convenience store chain mode, intelligent box mode, “scattered little stores” mode(similar with “Collect+” mode), self-run store mode and express service point mode, this paper then introduce the process of consumer going to pick up parcels and the mode of distribution mode of the convenience store chain mode and “scattered little stores in society” mode. And then the advantages and disadvantages of these five modes are analyzed, and finally the evaluation index system of B2C e-commerce business choosing CDP was designed in this paper.

articleTitle: Benevolent leadership, psychological capital and civil servants' service performance: Psychological capital as a moderator
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the grass-roots civil servants and aims at identifying the influence mechanism of benevolent leadership on their service performance and the role of psychological capital among the triadic relationship. The result of hierarchy regression analysis about 350 sample data showed that both benevolent leadership and psychological capital had significantly positive effect on grass-roots civil servant's service performance, while psychological capital acted as a moderator between benevolent leadership and grass-roots civil servant's service performance. Therefore, it is highly recommended that public organizations should pay attention to the individual's spiritual need, create a caring atmosphere so as to improve the service performance of grass-roots civil servants, increase the administrative efficiency and further promote the harmonious society

articleTitle: The empirical research of job satisfaction and employee's union commitment
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the Jiangsu, Zhejiang and other area 350 state ownership enterprise employees' questionnaire survey, this paper introduced horizontal collectivism variables, using hierarchical regression method to explore the moderating effect of horizontal collectivism between job satisfaction and the union commitment. Specifically, in this paper, on the one hand, tested the relationship between job satisfaction and the union commitment, Chinese employees in the process of decision to join the union, the external satisfaction and internal satisfaction is almost equally important. With the studies abroad, study abroad is pointed out that the relationship between the union commitment and economic satisfaction than “non-economic” satisfaction will be more intense; On the other hand, In this paper, for the internal mechanism between job satisfaction and union commitment, we provides a new theoretical perspective. Found that horizontal collectivism cultural factors may moderate the relationship between job satisfaction and union commitment.

articleTitle: Optimization of commercial vehicles' distribution routes
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of commercial vehicles' distribution routes and transportation mode, as well as the reliability of service, a distribution optimization model is constructed which considered the transportation cost, transit cost and punishment cost. Then apply genetic algorithm to solve the problem. Finally, used the data from a vehicle logistics enterprise for analyzing, which proved that the arithmetic is effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Ordering strategies for supply chain financing based on the newsboy model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper applies the supply chain financial management to deal with the cash constraints of the newsboy model. Considering the credit line and bankruptcy risk of the retailer, we analyzed the optimal orders of the retailer. In the new model, the sales of the product, financing interest and credit period are also considered. Then, we solve the model and obtain a series of useful management conclusions through sensitivity analysis and comparison with the classical newsboy model. The proposed model provides a new method for the retailers to administrate the cash and inventory.

articleTitle: Scene Perception in IoE era
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: IoE (Internet of Everything) is the new wave next to Mobile Internet and Internet of Things when both bond together. To make it happen, there must be new enabling technologies. In this paper, we discussed the implementation of Scene Perception in IoE era which is based on the enterprise mobile application “container-cloud” model and software-defined applications platform.

articleTitle: Evolution analysis of transport public sectors expanding trap
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By researching the Evolutionary Game in every corresponding relationship between Government Official and the Private in Chinese ancient transport industry, an evolution analysis of transport public sectors expanding trap has been constructed. Lack of independent third-party restrict, stimulated by revenue growth, the government officials constantly expanded transport public sectors, increased investment and management intensity. These actions decreased the normal operating income of the Private. Extensive social cost was transferred to underclass organizations and people, gradually intensified social contradictions and formed negative incentives and disintegration force to the existing system. Developing countries with imperfect “Independent judicature” and third-party restrict still need to pay high attention to the seriousness of such rules.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation and research of the rural logistics capability in Hebei province
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The article based on the fuzzy matter-element method to build index system, which including rural economic environment, logistics capability and logistics potential, the three elements and its subordinate 16 indicators, then make a comprehensive evaluation of logistics capability of rural areas in Hebei province according to the time dimension. And with the actual data from 2006 to 2013 in Hebei province as the foundation, this paper has carried on the quantitative analysis. Results show that the rural logistics competition environment has obviously improved, logistics capability is rising rapidly, and logistics potential is bigger in Hebei province. The article thinks through reasonably playing an important role of government in the construction of rural logistics, strengthening the construction of talent team, improving the agricultural products' commodization rate, and constructing the modern agricultural product market system to improve rural logistics capability in Hebei province.

articleTitle: End-to-end supply chains: The solution?
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The focus onto the final customer is one of the major sources to design and improve the value adding processes of a company. By having the customer's delight [1] in the mind it is required to direct the majority of processes to this delightful momentum. End-to-end supply chain management is exactly stressing on this focus. However, this end-to-end point of view is not new: the customer order cycle is already addressing this since many decades. Hence the question arises “What's new?” Answer: the strong commitment to the circular logistical momentum. Several process layers are linked together and controlled by a customer supply chain controller. In this article these different process layers are explored and a controlling tool developed to achieve such a customer-focused supply chain management. Based on empirical examples of the automotive industry and literature research the different aspects for this paper are retrieved. After these explanations a critical conclusion shows limits of such an end-to-end supply chain and gives ideas for further research fields.

articleTitle: Study on strategic risk evaluation model of power grid enterprises based on fuzzy evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: At present, most of the researches on strategic risk assessment are focused on general enterprises, which don't consider the character of power grid enterprises. This paper makes up for the limitations, establishing a strategic risk evaluation index system from three aspects: strategic environment risk, enterprise resources risk and enterprise ability risk. Then it builds a strategic risk evaluation model using fuzzy evaluation method and takes S company as an example to test the model. The result shows that the model is effective, which can reflect strategic risk of power grid enterprise objectively. The paper not only expands the research framework of strategic risk evaluation in theory, but also provides decision method for management of power grid enterprises in practice.

articleTitle: Decision-making of contracting reverse logistics to retailers
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Collection is the primary activity in reverse logistics. In this paper we address the problem of contracting the collection to the retailer for electronic waste. Since the legal or formal recycling enterprises are facing fierce competition from individual collectors and household workshop in China, they are in short of processing resources of electronic waste. The paper compared the strategy of subcontracting the collection to the retailer and collection by the recycler herself. We find the boundary incentives, and the result shows that using the retailer's marketing network is helpful to increase the flow of electronic waste for formal enterprises. In addition, we find that the recycler and retailers are both inclined to control the collection themselves when electronic waste with high value.

articleTitle: Computer-assisted language learning and the improvement on reading ability
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Reading has always been important in the context of foreign language teaching and learning. It is the basic competence for the acquisition of language knowledge and the improvement of listening, speaking, writing and translating abilities. With the wide application of computer and internet to the use of language education, “computer-assisted language learning (CALL) has become increasingly integrated into research and practice in general skills of reading, writing, speaking and listening…”[1]. As China's national curriculum of College English Curriculum Requirements requires that college English should be computer and classroom-based and college students should be competent in using English in a well- rounded way and be able to study independently. Therefore the paper will aim at promoting students' reading ability with means of computer and web-based language learning.

articleTitle: Study on allocation of cement logistics capacity in service supply chain perspective
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The concept of service supply chain helps us to consider service from different perspective. The service supply chain which is comprised by the service provider, service integrator and customer enterprise can create more value through collaborations. This paper studies the bulk cement transport business, analyzes the cooperation between the logistics service integrator and the logistics service provider. A transport capacity allocation model is established according to the feature of the cement transportation, so as to maximize the satisfaction of the capacity owners and minimize the total transportation cost at the same time. The model solution is provided and a numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on column-store databases optimization techniques
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Column-stores, store each database table column separately, with attribute values belonging to the same column stored contiguously, compressed, and densely packed, as opposed to traditional database systems that store entire records (rows) one after the other. The main features of it are good query efficiency, less disk access, less storage, and significant improvement of database performance. This paper gives an overview of key optimization techniques used in column-oriented database system.

articleTitle: Study over on-time delivery rate of orders executed by IT manufacturing SME based on supply chain collaboration
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With rapid development experienced by IT industry, small and medium-sized IT equipment manufacturers(IT SME) are facing a lot of problems. According to status of small and medium-sized IT equipment manufacturers in the supply chain, combining with characteristics of IT equipment manufacturing industry, under the theory of demand uncertainty and supply chain collaboration, this paper is to solve the problem on low rate of order on-time delivery by constructing the supply chain coordination model.

articleTitle: Research on the distribution system in E-commerce logistics based on gridding management
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Physical Distribution is a bottleneck in E-commerce and reverse logistics has become a bottleneck restricting the development of e-commerce. This paper constructs the distribution system in E-commerce logistics based on gridding management, via the comparison analysis between grid and non-grid distribution system in E-commerce logistics through computer simulation, verifies the grid used in e-commerce distribution system is correct and sets up a service quality evaluation system. Comprehensive simulations and comparisons show that the gridding model is practically optimal and theoretically promising.

articleTitle: Technology innovation's region nonlinear research: Evidence from China's OFDI
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The paper uses threshold test method to measure the regional absorptive capacity which based on economic development, R&D level and human capital. Results show that GDP, per capita GDP and the development of higher education level have single threshold. R&D spending has double threshold as well as R&D density. Human capital stock exists triple threshold. Absorptive capacity over a certain threshold, the effect of OFDI technology innovation will be improved significantly in some parts of China. A small number of eastern coastal areas can effectively absorb the OFDI technological innovation effect. The vast majority of central and western regions still not across the high threshold of absorptive capacity.

articleTitle: A research on network structure of DEA models and its application on China's airport
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The production process may have internal or network structure, for example, a company may have several production lines which use different inputs to produce the outputs, and there may be connection activities (or intermediate products) among the production lines. The traditional data envelopment analysis (DEA) models cannot be directly employed to measure the performance of this kind of decision making unit (DMU) as they treat the production system as a whole, disregarding the internal production process when calculating the efficiency. Depending on the characteristics of the DMU's inputs and outputs, this paper first classifies the network structure of DEA models.
