Then, a network DEA model is proposed to evaluate the airport's efficiency, and 20 major airports' system efficiencies, ground service efficiencies, passenger transport efficiencies, and freight transport efficiencies are analyzed systematically.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the development degree of high technology industry cluster
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By taking Beijing high technology industry cluster as the research object, this paper utilizes such analysis indexes as industrial concentration ratio, space Gini coefficient and industrial agglomeration rate to complete the evaluation on the development degree of Beijing high technology industry cluster and to make analysis on the empirical results based on the discussion on the status quo of industry cluster and the evaluation methods for the development degree of industry cluster through empirical investigation.

articleTitle: The research of business intelligence system based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, China's ports continuously improve the level of information, with remarkable achievements in improving service processes, improving operational efficiency, logistics, port services has become more automated and intelligent. But with the increasingly fierce competition in the port business, simply increased automation and operational efficiency can't meet the demand for port development, there are many problems in business operations and business decisions because lack of business intelligence applications, resulting in the port. The value of this paper is that the specific business decisions can be linked with business intelligence optimization theory and practice in port, which is full utilization of the characteristics of the port business data. Data mining technology and business intelligence systems combine to achieve financial risk control port and customer policy management, decision-making ability of enterprises to improve the port.

articleTitle: Research on emergency logistics center location decision approach based on synthetic information entropy
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we take a full consideration to the location impact factors of emergency logistics center, which is technology, economy, environment and society and so on, based on sorting of the research results on the emergency logistics center location. Then, we build the hybrid multiple attribute index system of emergency logistics center location selection, and put forward the calculation method of a hybrid multiple attribute value transformation, fuzzy comprehensive quantitative and fuzzy information entropy, and established the location selection model of the emergency logistics center based on comprehensive information entropy method. Finally, we specify the model by an example. The results indicate that the method is effective, operability, and innovative.

articleTitle: The effect of regulatory pressure on the capital level and risk level in Chinese banks
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The outbreak of the US subprime mortgage financial crisis swept across the world in 2008 and international regulatory authorities adopted the most representative measure-Basel III- against the crisis in 2010. The present work brings insight into the effect of capital regulation on commercial bank based on the panel data of ten Chinese commercial banks from 2006 to 2013. This paper uses the multiple linear regression equation which was established by Shrieves and Dahl. This work chooses capital level and risk level as the dependent variables. The evaluating variables are bank's size of asset, net profit level, rate of bad loans, regulatory pressure and ownership structure. The results show that the regulatory pressure has negative effect on capital level, while nearly has no significance on risk level.

articleTitle: Partitioning the object-attribute space for data mining based on the merger of object elements
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The research of partitioning the object-attribute space belongs to the domain of interpretative structural modeling and it is one of the basic problems in the data mining field. Firstly this paper proposes and demonstrates the Subsystem Judgment theorem. In order to solve the problem above, an algorithm that reduces the scale and the dimension of the original data through partitioning the object-attribute space based on the merger of object elements is put forth. In the last part of the paper, a numerical value example is provided to show the whole process of the method.

articleTitle: Enhancing International Science and Technology Training Program with mobile application
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Mobile Apps, as a kind of widely accepted software developed for users on their mobile devices, have been expected to play important roles in improving the quality of training courses and enhancing the process of management in science and technology training sessions. In this paper, we investigated some requirements within the process of execution and management of the International Science and Technology Training Program, and presented a mobile app, ITP app, designed for overseas participants and management team members of this program to achieve a better training courses experience. The features cover nearly the whole process of a training session, including information-pushing, participants registration, session selection and subscribing, curriculum quality evaluation and procedure controlling. The feedback of the app users and test results show that ITP app can improve the quality of training and enhance the efficiency of management-process significantly.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the impact of knowledge absorptive capacity on service innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Knowledge absorptive capacity has an important impact on the service innovation performance of the service-based enterprise. This paper chooses the competitive advantage and customer satisfaction to measure the service innovation performance, analyzes the impact of knowledge absorptive capacity on the competitive advantage and customer satisfaction, and does an empirical research as the example of service outsourcing enterprises by using the structural equation model. The conclusion is that the improvement of knowledge absorptive capacity is conducive to improving the competitive advantage and customer satisfaction of service outsourcing enterprises, then improving the service innovation performance.

articleTitle: The research on small express depreciation of fixed assets in the road long-distance passenger transport
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The tax change from business tax to Value Added Tax in transportation enterprise in 2013, which is undoubtedly a good opportunity for the future of transportation enterprise's development, but this requires transportation enterprise must be accurately calculating transportation cost. From 10 road long-distance bus terminals in Beijing and Luoyang, we found that transportation cost was not accounted on the express highway long-distance passenger transport small goods station of the business, and the evidence is lack when making freight cost. In order to solve the key problem, this paper analyzes the management cost, puts forward the methods of station express opportunity cost and the Originating station should make accelerated depreciation to fixed capital. In the end, an example is given to illustrate the small computation methods and steps express cost of the goods.

articleTitle: The analysis of closed-loop supply chain with dual channel based on carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper brings carbon emissions into the category of carbon management. The decision-making behavior of members of the system is analyzed respectively based on Lagrange duality theory and variational inequality theory. The equilibrium of the dual channel closed-loop supply chain network is built and the equilibrium conditions of all members and the whole supply chain is obtained. Besides, the modified projection algorithm is designed for solving the equilibrium pattern.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise develop strategies under low-carbon advantages of multimodal transport
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Starting with the low-carbon advantages of multimodal transport, low-carbon economy fast developing and shipping enterprise's development transforming to multimodal logistics service as the background, this paper discusses the multimodal transport enterprise develop strategies based on low-carbon logistics. We calculate the carbon emission of the main low-carbon logistics service activities of multimodal transport from international shipping services and multimodal transport logistics value-added services. The emission concludes the major carbon emission influencing factors of multimodal transport enterprise implementing low-carbon logistics, providing a theoretical basis for path modal building of multimodal transport enterprises implementing low-carbon logistics. In the end, we propose four suggestions for shipping operation, multimodal transport enterprise implementing low-carbon logistics strategy from technology, management and market.

articleTitle: The comparative study on carbon taxes and carbon trading mechanisms under conditions of uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Global warming has become the most serious challenges the world are facing, and excessive emissions of greenhouse gases has caused widespread concern. In response to the worse-becoming environmental pollution and the greenhouse effect, two measures are commonly adopted in the world to suppress carbon dioxide emissions, namely carbon tax and carbon trading. Dynamic time model is utilized in this paper to analyze the comparative study on carbon taxes and carbon trading mechanisms under conditions of uncertainty. The conclusion shows that: 1. When the degree of tilt marginal abatement cost curve is greater and the degree of tilt marginal revenue curve more hours is smaller, the carbon tax has a comparative advantage gradually, otherwise the carbon trading mechanism has a comparative advantage gradually. 2. With the increase of the stock retention rate, carbon trading mechanism has a comparative advantage gradually.3. With the increase of time discount, carbon trading has a comparative advantage gradually.4.Correlation exists between the presence of abatement cost and emission reduction benefits.

articleTitle: Discussion on influence factors and evaluation of customer experience for B2C E-commerce enterprises
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the rapid development of E-commerce, more and more E-commerce enterprises attach great importance to customer experience, and B2C E-commerce enterprises make no exception. Based on previous research literatures, the research discusses influence factors of customer experience for B2C E-commerce enterprises, establishes index system of customer experience for B2C E-commerce enterprises, apply analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each level index, establishes the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, finally conducts the case study which shows that it is more reasonable and scientific to evaluate customer experience for B2C E-commerce enterprises with analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the profit model of enterprise experience marketing based on customer experience
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Experience marketing win more competitive advantages for modern enterprises as a new business model in the network economy era. This paper explores the formation and realization of user experience value through the analysis of characteristics of consumer behaviors in the network economy era, analyzes profit model of enterprise experience marketing in our country from the perspective of user experience and its operational mechanism, and puts forward “free experience” and “non-free experience” are two ways of profit model of enterprise experience marketing.

articleTitle: Study on organization informatization management based on information resources sharing mechanism
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: During investigation process of organization informatization management, prone to produce shortage problem of the wireless spectrum resource, the traditional organization informatization management method based on service information causes congestion and waste of resources, due to the low utilization of information, cannot effectively achieve organizational information management, an organization informatization management method based on information resources sharing mechanism is proposed, two conditions need to meet shared agreement between organizations. Two quasi matrix for tagging channel characteristics in information resource sharing mechanism are analyzed. With the information resource sharing mechanism to complete the two scene of organization informatization management. When a plurality of non-authorized users compete at the same time, priority of all the node is found, under the condition of no effect on the authorized user normal communication, the non-authorized users of largest priority accessed in the organization. In order to reduce the interference authorized users have, need to reject non authorized user, and solve priority of rejection of any node, higher priority is easier to be refused. Simulation results show that, the proposed method has high effectiveness and practicability in the organization informatization management.

articleTitle: Personalized recommendation algorithm based on situation awareness
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the increasing number of mobile devices and the development of all kinds of mobile technology, the volume of data is getting larger and larger. People have to face huge amounts of data. At the same time, as the continuous development of various mobile devices providing more data acquisition technology, the dimension of data have a bigger growth too. It's not enough for the existing technology in the treatment of huge amounts and high dimension data. User's interests in different time have been taken into equal consideration with the method being used, which leads to lack of effectiveness in the given period of time. In order to solve this problem, personalized recommendation is faced with great challenge. What's more, timeliness which is getting more and more urgent in people's need is very important. Towards the problem of recommendation based on context-aware, this paper propose a personalized recommendation algorithm based on user context clustering, with the consideration of timeliness. This algorithm uses the idea of contextual pre-filtering. A method of fuzzy clustering is used on the users' context in history data set first to construct the user set which is similar with current user context, and then combined with user-based collaborative filtering algorithm for personalized recommendation.

articleTitle: System scheme design of aviation containerized supplies in transited yard
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: How to quickly find the aviation containerized unit supplies needed in the bulk of the goods is studied, so to meet the aviation installed demand, implement the rapid transiting of supplies. Considering the characteristics of aviation container unit supplies to be transported in stockpiling and the transmitting supplies storage areas, long distance radio frequency identification system is designed. The working frequency, the antenna system, communication method, electronic tag and reader are designed. Finally, the main functions of the system are set up, and system analysis has been carried on.

articleTitle: A study on coordination degree evaluation of Logistics supply and demand in Free Trade Zone
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on Shanghai Pilot Free Trade Zone (FTA), the author has studied the coordination degree evaluation of Logistics supply and demand in FTA. Firstly author gives the selecting principle of order parameter. Based on the principle and combined with the actual situation of Shanghai Free Trade Zone, I used the three subsystems-transportation, warehousing, value-added services to set up index system of supply and demand order parameter respectively. On this basis, I established evaluation model of coordination degree on logistics supply and demand, including coordination model of the supply and demand system and relative coordination model of supply and demand subsystem. Model can be used on the coordination degree evaluation of Logistics supply and demand in FTA, and guiding the development of logistics industry in the free trade area.

articleTitle: Cooperation model with direct and retail channels
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Manufacturers today are increasingly adopting a direct online channel to sell their products. Empirical studies have shown that service quality even goes beyond product price as one of the major factors influencing consumers' acceptance of the direct channel. But due to lack of manpower resources and material resources, manufacturer will spend much more service costs than retailer to receive the same service quality. In this paper, we assume that service costs is valued by the service sensitivity of consumer, and thus manufacturer and retailer should share service costs together through the proportion of k which is strictly determined by service sensitivity of consumer. Finally, we present a cooperation model for centralized or decentralized dual-channel supply chain.

articleTitle: A PROV-O based approach to web content provenance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Data provenance is currently a hot issue, and many webpages still lack provenance annotation. PROV-O is an emerging W3C recommendation for a provenance data model and language. In this paper, through the analysis of web document derivation, we define a document as an entity and extract a number of semantic properties about document features. A semantic similarity clustering method is used to determine the relationship during the changes of documents. Feature words variation and the responsible person can be found with the aid of PROV-O. Then, taking “genetically modified” news Webpages as test documents, we verify the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Stock trends prediction combining the public opinion analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Stock market is complex and volatile, the stock price trends is not only related to the stock price history, but also have a certain correlation with the national policy, the economic environment and the unexpected events of company. Most of the existing stock market prediction methods are only based on the history of stock price and neglect the influence of public sentiment. Nowadays, Social networks such as micro-blog are developing rapidly and will greatly affect the behavior of investors. In this paper we present a system that combined the existing stock prediction method based on technical indicator with the public opinion analysis, and introduce the definition of micro-blog influence factors. The experiments on The Shanghai Composite Index show that this method can achieve higher accuracy than a single source system.

articleTitle: Effects of large shareholders' tunneling on executive incentive contract
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Large shareholders' tunneling can affect executive incentive contracts. We divide the executive incentive into explicit compensation and implicit incentive. Data from publicly listed companies in China during 2008-2013 shows that tunneling leads to decline in executive pay-performance sensitivity. In addition, tunneling also leads to significant increases in position-related consumption. The results indicate that tunneling reduces the effectiveness of executive incentive contracts.

articleTitle: The factors influencing the work stress of pilot using structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This Paper uses the structural equation model to analyze the relation between the work stress of pilots and the factors causing the stress. The analysis of these factors aims to provide theoretical basis for the stress management for pilot.

articleTitle: Production strategy of carbon sensitive products under low-carbon policies
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies production strategy of a carbon sensitive products under the carbon tax and cap-trade policy. By introducing EOQ model and the demand function influenced by greenness preference, we draw following conclusions: first, the manufacturer's optimal production is positively related to greenness level of carbon sensitive product; second, Lower carbon tax and cap-trade will help increase carbon sensitive product production and promote the development of low-carbon economy; third, When the selling price of carbon emission rights is lower than the purchasing price, the cost of carbon sensitive product of higher greenness level is higher than the lower one. Studying the production strategy of carbon sensitive products not only help manufacturers develop more scientific production plans, but also alleviate climate warming, realizing sustainable development.

articleTitle: The research on psychological type of netizens in internet public opinion's embryonic stage: A case study of Malaysia Airlines loss of communication
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet, the propagation velocity of events via internet is faster than via traditional media, internet public opinion has drawn people's attention. The development of internet public opinion usually takes on periodicity, which can be roughly divided into five stages-the embryonic stage, the outbreak stage, diffusion stage, transition stage and decaying stage. The keynote of this paper is the research of embryonic stage in the internet public opinion. Firstly, this paper divides the psychological type of netizens in embryonic stage into three categories and eight kinds of specific psychology. Then this paper explains the internet public opinion's development trend of Malaysia Airlines loss of communication event in its embryonic stage from a psychological point of view. Finally, this paper gets the conclusion that the reason of embryonic stage in internet public opinion is not only the sensitivity of public opinion event itself, but also the psychological type of netizens in promoting.

articleTitle: Systemic view on service management in Shanghai World Expo
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: We will introduce our research on the service management in Shanghai World Expo from systemic view. We not only care the general queuing phenomena in the physical aspect, but also the psychological aspect in visitors and volunteers. Finally we wish study the systemic problem in the more large scale systems, including visitors, pavilions from various participated countries and organizers from State and Shanghai municipality, and lastly the wide netizens on the web, who care the activities related to world expo in all aspects. We use some concepts and methods in the complex system, such as self-similarity, self-organization, and also some concepts and theory from management science. Some of our colleagues also develop several advanced Information techniques for sensing the perception of the collective behavior happened in whole process in Expo.

articleTitle: The price game research under low-carbon policies regulation in duopoly market
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies the price game under low-carbon policies regulation in duopoly market, on condition of complete information. The results show that: Bertrand equilibrium of duopoly market will be influenced by the low-carbon policies. In detail, Bertrand equilibrium breaks under each policy's regulation; and the optimal pricing under policy's regulation are higher than those without regulation; further research indicates that, in three policies, it is the cap-and-trade policy that makes the enterprises' expect profit increase, in the meanwhile, makes the carbon emission reduce.

articleTitle: The research of analytical solution of hollow brick and porous media transient heat transfer
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: According to the structure of hollow brick and porous media, heat conduction mechanism can be analyzed in two-dimensional space. Using the physical coupling model of natural convection and heat conduction, heat transfer equation of hollow brick and porous media transient heat transfer can be got, the control equation adopts the finite volume method. Analytical solution of heat exchanger models can be deduced under constant heat flux and wall temperature boundary condition. Heat transfer law can be studied under the change of external environment. And the inner and outer temperature changing and delay characteristics can be obtained. By researching in temperature change, we can get that energy-saving effect of hollow and porous media brick is remarkable.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship between board governance and corporate performance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Board governance is at the core of the corporate governance, to establish a standard and reasonable structure is the important content of perfecting corporate governance mechanism. Board governance in China is in its infancy, the listed company's board of directors' governance situation is worrying, problems like the unreasonable structure, lack of effective incentive, insufficient supervision and constraint still exist. In this context, this paper selected the China's A-share listed companies as samples, based on the result of the empirical research of 2011-2013 data, we found board size, the chairman and general manager conditions, the number of board meetings were negatively correlated with corporate performance; the number of committees and the proportion of board shareholding were positively correlated with corporate performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Taekwondo tournament logistics demand and study on the theoretical framework
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Taekwondo tournament logistics as a special kind of logistics activity, deeply affect the rapid development of the logistics industry China sports. This paper used the method of literature, logical reasoning, analyze the demand situation of Taekwondo tournament logistics, propose the present stage appears Taekwondo tournament logistics problems in the development process, and on this basis to explore the theoretic framework of Taekwondo competitions of the logistics in order to further enrich and perfect the China sports logistics theory.

articleTitle: Carbon sensitive manufacturers' production strategy research with carbon emissions capacity policy
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper researches carbon sensitive product manufacturers' production strategy with carbon emissions capacity (Cap) policy, when manufacturers under deterministic demand and stochastic demand. The research shows: Cap policy regulations have influence on manufacturers' production and profits, and it's less than without Cap policy regulations. When production under no Cap policy regulations. With carbon sensitive coefficient increasing, manufacturers' profits decrease. When production under Cap policy regulations, with carbon sensitive coefficient increasing, manufacturers' profit increases by deterministic demand; manufacturers' profit decreases by stochastic demand.

articleTitle: The dynamic competitive strategy study of duopoly enterprises in the Low-carbon Emission policy regulation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The study is based on the “dynamic game of perfect information” theory and the Stackelberg leadership model-investment in green technology. In the regulation of Mandatory Carbon Emissions Capacity, cap-and-trade and Carbon Emission Tax, this paper discusses the production-pricing decision and Nash equilibrium of enterprises that are not well-matched in strength in the dynamic game of perfect information, which prove two enterprises, under different policies, can come up with the optimum strategies and get corresponding expected profits, And Obtain the relations for Dynamic competitive strategies between market leader and followers, comparing the decisions under different Low-carbon Emission policies to analyze the environmental benefit and economical benefit. The results of this study manifests: Low-carbon Emission policy affects all the optimum strategies and expected profits of duopoly enterprises. And the further study proves the Mandatory Carbon Emissions Capacity and Cap-and-Trade have far greater impact on the expected profits of the enterprises, thus leading that expected profits is more indeterminate.

articleTitle: The optimization research on the queuing system in highway long-distance bus terminal small express
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of logistics industry, the customer need to send more and more small items, and manpower and resources are limited which are provided by logistics companies for the customer, therefor when customers sent items to logistics department need to wait in line, If the time waiting in queue more than the longest waiting time that customer can tolerate, customers will choose other logistics companies. For a long time, Logistics Company will lose a lot of customers, and in the fierce market fight it also face the risk of bankruptcy. To optimize the queuing system and improve its market competitiveness, this paper simply introduces the business process of small goods, mainly studies the small express queuing system

articleTitle: Analysis and research of logistics requirements of the textile industry in some place based on KANO model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to quantify logistics requirements information of somewhere textile industry more effectively, provide reference data for the logistics development and upgrade the logistics services necessarily for textile industry in the region. Based on KANO model, the paper has studied the logistics services for textile industry and quantified requirements information. The paper has considered characteristical logistics requirements of textile industry in the region and tried to objectively treat subjective logistics requirements. So that the research requirements would be close to the real requirements in the area of logistics services.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of audit simulation interaction platform
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Informatization is the ultimate way out for audit method in China. In order to improve audit quality, the auditee's information system always needs to be restored on the auditors' environment by re-installing them. The kind of audit model brings great pressure to the auditors, not only is the heavy workload at each audit project, but also there is incompatibility problems between different operating systems and software versions. In response to these problems, this paper proposed a method using virtualization technology to deploy audit simulation system environment. Based on the analysis of current mainstream virtualization platform, this paper designed the realizing solution of audit simulation interaction system choosing the VMware vSphere virtualization platform and achieved deployment environment under the present equipments of the Lab. Finally, this paper compared and analyzed the audit simulation result before and after implementing virtualization deployment, evaluating the performance of systems and proving that using virtualization technology in audit simulation interaction system has many advantages.

articleTitle: Do Corporate Governance best practices play a determinant role in firm value? Evidence from Bolivia's national oil company
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper tries to answer the question of top management, public policy makers, researchers and scholars of how important the role of Corporate Governance (CG) and best practices are. Although there are plenty of previous researches, we find it necessary to conduct this study because we believe the outcome will be significant to Bolivia's corporate governance and best practices in order to support and validate the application of the CG's code as management strategy. Likewise, the lack of academic research about this subject in a developing country where these kinds of practices are just starting to be promoted is an important fact, enlightening firms to consider this public policy in order to be more competitive and efficient. We use Pearson's correlations analysis in contrast with multiple regression analysis to examine the significance of Board of directors' characteristics on financial performance ratios and the influence on firm value.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of foreign capital on China's retail industry security
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Since China adopted the policy of fully opening retail market at the end of 2004, the entrance of multinational retail enterprises brought the reality and potential impact on the domestic retail such as structure, controlling power and competitiveness. From the perspective of industrial safety concept, combined with the mature DEA model, this paper focus on analyzing the security of the four kinds of retailing forms with large market share: big supermarket, hypermarket, department store and the convenience store. The result indicating an insecure state of China's retail industry. Finally, the paper puts forward reasonable proposals for improving domestic retail industry in industrial safety and also for the continued healthy and steady growth of China's retail industry.

articleTitle: Study on duration calculate model of railway construction based on LSM
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Reasonable duration is very important in terms of construction. This study presents a new model for calculate the railway construction project duration by means of linear Scheduling method. It gives two kinds of activity combination, the two respectively the calculation method of combination of the construction duration. And the duration of the validity of the proposed method are determined verified by an actual railway project instance.

articleTitle: The duopoly producing strategy under carbon emissions regulation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: We investigate the duopoly producing strategy under carbon emissions including the carbon emissions tax, mandatory carbon emissions capacity and cap-and-trade. We use the game theory to analyze the duopoly manufactories production quantity strategies. Result shows, under each policy, we can find the Nash Equilibrium of two firms' optimal production quantity and expected profit. Specifically, we derive that duopoly market's profit is optimal when implementing the cap-and-trade policy.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis of agricultural products wholesale markets of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Agricultural products wholesale market is a key node in agricultural logistics. Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region is a significant economic region in China in the future and it'll be very important to analyze the efficiency of agricultural products wholesale markets in this region in order to improve the agriculture. This paper uses the Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) within software “deap 2.1” to analyze the technical efficiency and scale efficiency of the agricultural products wholesale markets in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. The result shows that: in these three areas, agricultural products wholesale markets located in Tianjin and Hebei area are low efficient and in the scale efficiency increasing stage. On the contrary, the wholesale markets for agricultural products located in Beijing are high and economy of scale is degressive. And resources of constructing wholesale markets in Beijing should be transferred to Tianjin and Hebei.

articleTitle: Beijing cultural and creative industry policy effect evaluation based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper constructs the policy effect evaluation system for Beijing cultural and creative industry, using entropy method to determine the weight and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to analyze effect, and then put forward the suggestions. The results show that the policy of Beijing cultural and creative industry have played itself role, and whose implementation effect is well. But, from the view of rule of industrial development, the ideal of establishing policy of Beijing cultural and creative industry should be adjusted, and realize that through legislation the market is playing a decisive role in allocating resources.

articleTitle: The impact of market uncertainty on collaboration with suppliers and operational performance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the impact of market uncertainty on e-connection and process coordination with suppliers and the operational performance. A Structure Equation Model containing two intermediary variables is established. Through an empirical survey of 725 samples in an international study, the research findings show that: (1) market uncertainty has a negative impact on operational performance and has a positive impact on e-connection and process coordination with suppliers. (2) process coordination with suppliers has a positive impact on operational performance. (3) e-connection with suppliers has a positive impact on operational performance. (4) each of e-connection and process coordination with suppliers partly mediate the effect of market uncertainty on operational performance.

articleTitle: Distribution mode of small items using passenger-transport expressway networks
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Enlightened by the fact that certain passenger buses could deliver small items by imposing some fees for clients, and there exists possible integration of the passenger-transport expressway networks and logistics, we aim to study how to transfer the delivery of simple and small items to logistics distribution of special items by using expressways if we take time-efficient special items as the research object. Choosing automobile passenger stations, expressway service areas and toll-gates as joints, and relying on the luggage compartments of passenger vehicles, this paper analyzes and studies the route choice of the distribution of small items by using expressway networks, and presents new modes and methods to the distributions of time-efficient small items.

articleTitle: Study on the integrated logitsics system of Shanghai FTZ and relationship of its main elements
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we research the construction of integrated logistics system of Shanghai free trade zone (FTZ) according to its characteristics, and on the basis of constructing integrated logistics system, we also research the relationship between internal elements using system dynamics. Compared with the general logistics systems, the logistics supply subject, demand subjects and service platform in Shanghai FTZ integrated logistics system are more complex. The characteristics of Shanghai FTZ should be taken full account while constructing the system dynamics model that describes the relationship between main elements of Shanghai FTZ integrated logistics system. We should plan and construct Shanghai FTZ integrated logistics system with dynamic view to achieve the coordinated development of its various elements.

articleTitle: The research of tourists' space-time behavior in Beijing Dashilaner
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper takes the space-time behavior patterns of tourists in Beijing Dashilaner scenic spot as the research object, tries to study the behavior of tourists from the angle of time geography, and the empirical research shows that time, space, and path which play an important role on tourists' behavior. Based on the analysis of the basic patrons characteristics of the Beijing Dashilaner, carrying out the study of tourists' behavior patterns by using the methods of literature analysis, questionnaire investigation and space-time path analysis. Categorizing the tourists' space-time behavior patterns can help us to understand tourists' tourism activities and their needs more clearly, according to this, we can optimize scenic tourist routes and tourism products, and meet various needs of tourists. It is important to improve the quality of products of the scenic area and the quality of tourists' experience.

articleTitle: Bp neural network model for prediction of listing Corporation stock price of Qinghai province
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The article based on analyzing the theory of stock investment and the stock price prediction method, starting from the practical point of view, by describing the background and significance in Qinghai province listing Corporation stock price forecasting, which makes people aware of the importance of the stock prediction, introduces the stock prediction theory and the theory of BP neural network. This paper takes western mining and Qinghai gelatin which are two listing Corporation of Qinghai province as an example for inquiry. Contrasting the forecast accuracy and change direction of three periods and comparing the prediction accuracy of different trading systems, it draws the preliminary conclusion.

articleTitle: Research of container transport process reengineering - a case study of Minsheng auto parts logistics
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The current market competition between enterprises in essence has been transformed into the competition between supply chain and supply chain. In the face of increasingly open international and domestic markets, Chinese automobile manufacturers must pay attention to the logistics cost control. Transportation cost and warehousing cost are two major cost in the logistic cost. Whether Chinese automobile enterprises can effectively control the cost of transportation and warehousing costs will be the key to the future survival and development. This paper mainly studies the cost control problems of container transportation in the Changan Ford automobile parts inbound logistics supply chain. Using PERT network analysis of the existing process cost,and the optimization is carried out. Finally the control effect and the degree of optimization of the container transportation process reengineering is discussed.

articleTitle: A two-stage model for transportation and distribution in disaster relief
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage integer programming model including depots to distribution centers and distribution centers to demand points. Hundreds of thousands of people lost their lives in disaster recently. Since to predict the timing and magnitude of a disaster is difficult, the resource requirement is with randomness. Besides, information asymmetry exists in the two stages, so the demand may not be satisfied in time. Based on the principle “time is life”, the model aims to provide more items to demand points as little time as possible with limited transport capacity. We use C-W savings algorithm to generate the routes for distribution in order to solve the model effectively. And a case study is presented to illustrate the effectiveness and applicability at last.

articleTitle: Quantization model of user experience for electronic information services
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Started from electronic information service connotation, this paper advances the new concept of the electronic information service based on quantization of user experience. Then, the user experience was classified into four levels. Furthermore, combining the three dimensions with the four experience levels, it built a user experience quantitative index system of electronic information services, and ultimately set up a user experience quantitative concept model of electronic information services. It can provide necessary theoretical basis and practical guidance for further empirical research.

articleTitle: Logistics center origin of agricultural products in Hebei province
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The development of agricultural products logistics in Hebei province has become faster and faster. How to choose the location as Logistics Center Origin of agricultural products distribution in Hebei Province, according to the transportation network and agricultural products distribution within short distance and most convenient transportation, is quite significant to the government, agricultural enterprises and farmers. This paper uses mathematical analysis method to determine logistics transportation center origin weighted on traffic volume and highway web on Euler circle of agricultural products in Hebei Province, in order to provide reference for the government and enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on the passenger car logistics transportation loading problem of company H
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The passenger car logistics transportation loading problem of company H is investigated. Based on reasonable assumptions, the passenger car logistics transportation loading problem is transformed into a two-dimensional packing problem. Firstly, under the premise of considering the sizes of two types of car carriers and three kinds of passenger cars, and the stability requirements of car carriers, 36 kinds of possible loading modes of type 1-1 car carriers and 73 kinds of possible loading modes of type 1-2 car carriers are enumerated by using MATLAB program. Then, the integer programming model of passenger car logistics transportation loading problem is constructed to minimize the total transportation cost. A LINGO program is given to solve the model. Using the mathematical model and LINGO program, we obtain the number of two types of car carriers and the loading mode of each car carrier which company H can use to complete the given transport task. The results of this paper can provide a theoretical basis for the logistics company to make passenger car logistics transportation plans.

articleTitle: Research on metro lines material consumption based on stochastic time series
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the improvement of city public transportation and economic development, the rapid development of urban rail transit makes the subway an increasingly important role. This paper analyzes the metro line and the metro line materials to study the consumption laws of metro line materials. Based on stochastic time series, this paper constructed metro line operation and maintenance of material consumption law model, first using the MATLAB mathematical software trend curve fitting material consumption; reuse Markov probability matrix material consumption prediction methods analyze data fluctuating around the trend curve changes law. Finally, the Beijing subway line fastener accessories as an example to empirical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on guarantee mechanism of waste concrete recycling logistics mode in Beijing city
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Recycling logistics mode of waste concrete is one of the important ways to improve the sustainable development of the construction industry. Recycling logistics have the obviously advantages in such aspects as economy and environmental protection, but there is a big problem when concrete operation. In this paper, taking Beijing city as an example, survey the current situation of the recycling of waste concrete in Beijing, combined with the survey data and the actual situation, analysis the reasons it is difficult to achieve recycling logistics, and put forward the guarantee measures from some aspects.

articleTitle: Application of gray theory in the prediction of Shenzhen waterway passenger traffic
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Now the waterway passenger transport of Shenzhen is the national development of the best waterway passenger transport market. With the better understanding of the future of Shenzhen waterway passenger demand trend, we can grasp the development direction of Shenzhen waterway passenger transport more clearly. Based on the gray theory forecasting method, the prediction of the Shenzhen waterway passenger volume is more accurate. It is also proved that the result of prediction in using this model is very credible. The prediction has good feasibility and operability. It will also provide better reference for the development of both waterway passenger transport and other related industries. And then it will provide a scientific basis for Shenzhen waterway passenger to define related development policy.

articleTitle: An evolutionary game model between Governments and manufacturers with return of E-wastes
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: An evolutionary game model between the governments and the manufacturers was developed. The stability conditions of parties, their behaviors, and the effect of some parameters on their stability, were analyzed. The results shows that the penalty system and supervision cost of the government have much impact on final results. And the feasible regulation polices can effectively promote manufacturers to return and process e-wastes.

articleTitle: ICT, trade in financial service and economic growth
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Information and communication technology (ICT) had been rapid developing by leaps and bounds. At the same time, global trade in financial services (TFS) also experienced a fast-growing stage. This article aimed to examine jointly ICT-growth nexus and TFS-growth nexus and to investigate whether the interaction between ICT and TFS facilitates economic growth in the context of China. There were two main findings in this article. First, we found that both ICT and TFS have significant and positive effects on economic growth, respectively. Second, the interaction between ICT and TFS exerted a significant but negative impact on economic growth. We then made a further discussion on the mediation role of TFS in the relationship between ICT and economic growth, and found the same evidence that TFS failed to mediate the relationship between ICT and economic growth. Finally, we pointed out policy implications drawn from our analyses and findings.

articleTitle: Research on port customer classification based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Customer is an important strategic resources for enterprise, only use effective customer management can promote the development of the enterprise. Customer classification management is the key to customer relationship management, and the key to effective customer classification is to select the appropriate classification index and effective classification method. In this paper, the customer classification index is extract from the analysis of customer value, at the same time, customer classification method is selected by comparing the different classification methods. Based on the comprehensive analysis of Subtraction Clustering, fuzzy K-Prototypes algorithm and the improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, the algorithm of RBF Neural Network was improved and a new RBF Neural Network model was built. Then I apply the model to the port on the customer classification. Finally using MATLAB to simulate and verify the validity of the model on the customer classification.

articleTitle: The application of game theory in mobile social media security analysis for companies
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Using the social media services is becoming more and more popular nowadays. For companies and their employees, they communicate with customers and colleagues with the new ways of social media. More and more people tend to use mobile social media service at any time and any place but mobile virus and malware are dramatically increasing in frequency. The mobile social media has become a very popular attack target of attackers because of the security risks associated with mobile social media. The information security administrators of companies must take security solutions to defend against these sophisticated attackers. This paper applies game theory to analyze the possibility of the attackers' attacks and suggests the defensive strategies for the defenders.

articleTitle: Building reverse supply chain of waste mobile phones based on e-commerce platform
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper analyzed current reverse supply chain of waste mobile phones and create a new mode of reverse supply chain of waste mobile phones based on e-commerce platform. The process structure of this new reverse supply chain is built in this paper. The cost structure of the new mode was established and then we compared the cost of the new recovery mode and other current recovery modes. At last, the advantages of recycling waste mobile phones based on e-commerce platform have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Effect of axis parallel error on the rotor mechanical properties under high acceleration
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Rotor mechanical properties under high acceleration is affected synthetically by a number of factors, in order to improve the operating characteristics of the rotor, the rotor with holes will be taken as the example, then the finite element model of the rotor with parallelism error is established, and by changing the distance between the hole and the rotor rotation center (denoted e), the influence of parallel error on stress and strain distribution of the rotor is analyzed, the results show that when e <182mm, the deviation of maximum stress value caused by parallel error is 5%, when e reaches 186mm, the maximum error caused by the parallel error is about 100%, the greater e should be avoided in design.

articleTitle: The research of the enterprise cooperation strategy under different carbon emissions' policies
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The problem of the global climate change significantly attracts the attention of the world, and all countries are trying their bests to reduce emissions of the carbon dioxide, which is imperative. In the process of low carbon supply chain, this article considers two kinds of carbon emission reduction policies: the carbon tax and the carbon trading, and builds game model of carbon emission reduction in both cases: the supply chain cooperation and non-cooperation. The research results show that no matter under the carbon tax policy or under the carbon trading policy, the optimal carbon emission reduction rate of the manufacturers and retailers in the supply chain cooperation situation is not necessarily higher than that in the supply chain non-cooperation situation, the results also show that whether the supply chain enterprise should choose to cooperate with each other or not depends on the carbon tax rate and the price of carbon trading set by the government. The conclusion above can provide a theoretical support for the government to set reasonable carbon tax rate and carbon trading price and can also provide reference for enterprises to choose the appropriate cooperation mode.

articleTitle: Response effect assessment of Internet public opinion based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Response effect assessment of Internet public opinion is a very important aspect of Internet public opinion response. It can summarize the response and handling works of public opinion and make it clear to the advantages and disadvantages during the process, and then provide guidance to future work. This paper presents assessment program for response effect of Internet public opinion used AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, and through case studies to verity its effectiveness, which will provide a reference for the development of response of Internet public opinion.

articleTitle: Vehicles routing and scheduling algorithm for an automated storage and retrieval system of a warehouse
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: An automated storage and retrieval system is a new storage concept derived from a pallet-shuttle high-density-storage system. This new system (former system) has higher space utilization than the original one (latter system), and can store or retrieve palletized units automatically using automated storage & retrieval vehicles. In order to organize multiple vehicles moving orderly in the system, offline vehicle routing and online vehicle scheduling are performed, based on a path-net graph modeled from the racks and pallet lifters of the system. In offline vehicle routing, path payload and navigation factor are introduced to calculate the path cost, which can make the vehicles not only have short paths but also employ trunk rails and pallet lifters evenly. In online vehicle scheduling, to avoid vehicle collisions at path nodes, buffers are attached to path nodes in the path-net graph model for vehicle parking, and each vehicle can only pass through the path nodes after having acquired the authorization of the system. With the algorithm illuminated in this paper, the system can route and schedule vehicles efficiently, and the utilization rate of vehicles can achieve more than 98% and congestion rate of system less than 2%, with an appropriate number of vehicle.

Author Keywords: A Path-Net Graph Modeled from an Automated Storage and Retrieval System

articleTitle: Protecting enterprise information from employee's misappropriation in China
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Protecting enterprise information from employee's misappropriation is a crucial but significantly challenging task for many companies in China. Chinese labor laws provide a set of protection for enterprises together with responsibilities regarding employee's misappropriation. This article suggests that those legal instruments would not be effective unless the appropriate prevention mechanisms have been implemented, and therefore, it is rather crucial to introduce a set of “good practice” recommendations as to improve information management in workplace.

articleTitle: Decision-making on reverse logistics for manufacturers: an evolutionary game theory perspective
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Reverse logistics has become one of the most important competitive strategies for enterprises as environmental problems and resource issues have been serious. In this paper, an evolutionary game model is developed to analyze the reverse logistics decision for manufacturers. The decision-making process for implementin0067 the reverse logistics of the manufacturers under competitive market environment has been investigated in this paper. In addition, a dynamic evolutionary system is formulated to study the cooperation trends of manufacturers with recyclers. To verify the theoretical results, simulation experiments are conducted on MATLAB simulation platform. The results showed that manufacturer's decision-making process is influenced by people's attention on Enterprise Reverse Logistics in long-term perspective. In the implementation of the reverse logistics process, manufacturers can sign a contract with recyclers with incentives or penalty to ensure the supply of waste products. The results can guide manufacturers to make better decisions to promote the recycling of resources.

articleTitle: International experience of wealth management center to building Pearl River Delta WMC
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the post financial crisis era, global wealth market still shows a steady growth trend in the remaining wave. In the period of capital market recovery, China, as the most potential wealth market in the Asia Pacific region, has a huge space of wealth growing. In this context, how to seize the growth opportunities brought by new wealth, promote private capital agglomeration and efficient utilization and finally realize the steady growth of the national economy has become an extremely significant problem. This article summarize the experiences of establishment and construction of the world famous wealth management centers using the related theories of financial center, and make a comprehensive analysis of current situation of domestic wealth management and the strengths and limitations to build a wealth management center in Pearl River Delta(PRD). Finally, we seek the enlightenment to the construction of Pearl River Delta wealth management center (WMC), and put forward some appropriate policy recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise business model innovation in the perspective of value chain optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies the design of business model innovation and implementation process from the perspective of value chain optimization. Through the industry value chain and business model architecture, the paper put forward the theoretical framework, on the basis of which establishes the theory structure of business model innovation. In the case of Kalian Inc business innovation model, the model has made a further analysis of significance and reality. Hope to provide reference for enterprise to realize the transformation of business model.

articleTitle: Research on bus stopping time at the harbor-shaped bus stop
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The paper analyses the main factors that influence bus stops time at the bus stop, and bus bay stop time model is established. By comparing theoretic data with practical data, rationality and validity of the model was validated.

articleTitle: Research on the development of rural logistics in Shandong Province based on gray theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Rural logistics is an important part in the development of modern logistics. The development of the rural logistics is conducive to the formation of new social division of labor, and contributes to opening up new employment. It can also help to solve the surplus labor force in rural and play an important role in increasing farmers' income. This paper analyzes the influence factors which affect the development of rural logistics in Shandong Province with the help of grey theory. The result shows that the infrastructure construction of rural logistics, the number of the post office and the per capita net income of rural residents influence the development of rural logistics to a large extent. Combined with the result of the analysis, this paper proposes some advices: speeding up and expanding the infrastructure construction of rural logistics, improving the role of the postal network and constructing rural logistics information platform.

articleTitle: A methodology for the evaluation of automotive electronic components supplier's efficiency
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Supplier evaluation is one of the most important issues for supply chain management of enterprises. For automotive electronic products manufacturing enterprises, establishing a reasonable automotive electronic components' supplier evaluation index model and using appropriate evaluation methods to select the suitable suppliers is of great important for the production activities and the long-term development of the enterprises. Surveying the electronic components purchasing group of automotive business in R Company and analyzing the status and problems of electronic components supplier evaluation of R Company, this paper established the index for the evaluation model of electronic components supplier and proposed a method which combined AHP (analytic hierarchy process) and DEA (data envelopment analysis) to evaluated electronic components supplier based on discussion about the traits of electronic components and automotive electronic components industry. Finally, based on the model and method above, this paper did an empirical analysis using the purchasing data of R Company. The good evaluation effect made this research more practical and feasible and the related research findings may be available for some analogous companies as a reference.

articleTitle: Research on transformation and similarity measurement method of trend curves
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The similarity analysis of trend curves is the basis of detecting process rules. In this paper, a stage model related to the description, transformation and similarity measurement of trend curves is proposed. Furthermore, through the experiment, the feasibility of the model is illustrated.

articleTitle: Research on thematic structure modeling about China economy education management and analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: To determine the analysis subject is an important content of building data warehouse application system. In this paper, according to the characteristics of China educational economic management and analysis field, we research the method for determining the subject field that business requirements oriented. Business requirements collecting and subject fields modeling are described and summarized. Operational processes and methods example is provided at last of the paper.

articleTitle: GMDH based auto-regressive model for China's energy consumption prediction
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: It is very significant for us to predict future energy consumption accurately. As for China's energy consumption annual time series, the sample size is relatively small. This study combines the traditional auto-regressive model with group method of data handling (GMDH) suitable for small sample prediction, and proposes a novel GMDH based auto-regressive (GAR) model. This model can finish the modeling process in self-organized manner, including finding the optimal complexity model, determining the optimal auto-regressive order and estimating model parameters. Further, four different GAR models, AS-GAR, MR-GAR, SRMSE-GAR and SMAPE-GAR, are constructed according to different external criteria. We conduct empirical analysis on three energy consumption time series, including the total energy consumption, the total petroleum consumption and the total gas consumption. The results show that AS-GAR model has the best forecasting performance among the four GAR models, and it outperforms ARIMA model, BP neural network model, SVM regression model and GM (1, 1) model. Finally, we give the out of sample prediction from 2014 to 2020 by GAR model.

articleTitle: Innovation of enterprise profit patterns based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The information storm brought about by Big Data is changing our lives, work and thinking, and it's also bringing huge change to the survival environment of enterprises. Decision-making method of enterprises shifts from traditional subjective way to data-driven decision-making methods, precision marketing is becoming the new enterprise marketing tools, and social networks enhance customer satisfaction greatly. This paper analyzes how The Long Tail theory is used to expand enterprises product ranges. Mean well, the paper describes how to innovate new products or services under the condition of huge amount of potential customers. Finally, the author put forward a new business model based on Big Data thinking. In this model, enterprises have two different kind of interest. One is using big data to explore new product, new customers, precision marketing, diversified management, and analyze the loyalty of customers. The other one is taking big data itself as a new product and the transaction of big data as a new source of enterprise profits. The model will be a reference for the enterprises which will take advantage of Big Data to create new profit for the enterprises.

articleTitle: An approach based on FMECA methodology for a decision support tool for managing risk in Customs supply chain: A case study
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Risks such as smuggling of drugs, weapons or commercial fraud highlighted the vulnerability of the Customs supply chain. In fact, the economic, political and social impacts of those risks are highly detrimental to the countries, businesses and the public. Effective risk management in the customs supply chain could not only fulfill the safety requirements but also provide a competitive advantage in the commercial world. Making optimal decisions in this regard is not always as simple as it sounds, given the large number of actors, their complex structural links, and the interactions between them. The purpose of this paper is to develop a risk management approach enabling a structured analysis and an effective assessment of the risk in customs context. A Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis FMECA based methodology will be discussed to assess and analyze safety concerns for Moroccan Customs supply chain. As an input, it defines uncertainties in the system and it quantifies the risk using the criticality as a risk indicator. As an output, FMECA provides a list of most critical risks as well as some target mitigation actions. The proposed approach could be used not only to support the decision-making process, but also to provide a framework to better manage risks in Moroccan customs context.

Author Keywords: failure mode effects and criticality analysis (FMECA)

articleTitle: A buisness system towards supply chain finance based on complex network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The business control system of SCF is based on the technology of “credit binding” between the core enterprise and small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the supply chain. The new control system allows the business to cover all enterprises in the supply chain. In this paper, We refer to the concept of “business flow” in supply chain which regarded as a complex network, and consider the “overall crediting” problem of supply chain from the perspective of network topology, and use a optimization model to monitor the business flow in banks. We found that the system can provide help for the business design and decision making of banks.

articleTitle: Factors affecting the electric vehicle demonstration: 14 international cities/regions cases
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As an effective way to deal with the global energy crisis and environmental pollution, countries around the world interested in the development of electric vehicles. This paper describes a study of 14 selected international cities/regions - New York, Los Angeles, Portland, Kanagawa, Rotterdam, North Brabant, Amsterdam, Paris, Barcelona, Berlin, Hamburg, northeast England, Helsinki and Stockholm - that have been successful in promoting the use of electric vehicles. This paper summarizes some basic data, policies actors, and innovative activities as the factors affecting the electric vehicle development in the 14 cities/regions and discusses the overall affecting results of the use of electric vehicles in these cities/regions. Based on the correlation analysis on some key indicators the study analyzes the promotion policies of the cities/regions from four perspectives: (1) strategy and investment, (2) subsidy and tax policy, (3) regulation and standards, and (4) specialized agencies. This paper provides further analysis on demonstration projects and innovative activities in these four areas, as well as infrastructure development, project integration, and public awareness. The paper concludes with an analysis of the commonalities among the cities/regions on their policies and innovations and their experiences with electric vehicle innovation.
